facts.text: I think the platypus is a contender for the title of the most bizarre animal in the world.
I think the axolotl's ability to regenerate its limbs is pretty cool.
I wonder what it would be like if the platypus had the ability to regenerate its venomous spurs like the axolotl can regenerate its limbs.
I bet that if the platypus could regenerate its venomous spurs, it would become an even more formidable creature.
I think the platypus already has so many unique abilities.
I honestly don't think the platypus needs any extra abilities to be a formidable creature.
I think the platypus's venomous spurs and unique bill are enough to make me think twice before approaching one in the wild.

keyphrases: most bizarre animal in the world
